record.site_name: Micrometeorological studies project in Amazonian mangroves
record.site_desc: This tower is located in the experimental site of Cuiarana, northeast coast of the Brazilian Amazon, state of Pará, installed in a mangrove ecosystem, under the influence of the tidal pulses of the Atlantic Ocean and basic flow of the trade winds. It was installed in 2014, initially collecting CO2 concentration and then installed eddy covariance system.

grp_location.location_comment: The tower was installed in a mangrove ecosystem in the year 2014, containing an eddy covariance system (EC) with an open path gas analyzer. The tower is 12 meters high and the EC system installed is above the forest canopy by 2 meters. Predominance of mangrove vegetation, occurring the genera Avicennia and Rizophora.

grp_igbp.igbp_comment: Predominance of mangrove vegetation, occurring the genera Avicennia and Rizophora.
